nl: Something is an instance of MilitaryProcess.
Something in the theater is a MilitaryUnit.
Something at the base is a Weapon.
Every military unit is a military organization.
Attack is a kind of military process.
Weapon is a subclass of Artifact.
The agent relation holds between a MilitaryProcess and an AutonomousAgent.
Destination relates a Transportation to a Region.
A MilitaryUnit stands in the located relation to an Area.
For every military process, the agent relation holds with an autonomous agent.
cnl: every ?x is-a MilitaryProcess implies agent ?x AutonomousAgent

nl: For every transportation process, the destination relation holds with a region.
cnl: every ?x is-a Transportation implies destination ?x Region

nl: Every battle has a military unit as its patient.
cnl: every ?x is-a Battle implies patient ?x MilitaryUnit

nl: At least one military process exists.
Some entity is a Weapon.
There exists an order in the command post.
It is not the case that the agent relation holds between a MilitaryProcess and an AutonomousAgent.
A MilitaryUnit is not located in an Area.
Area, MilitaryUnit, and Region do not stand in the between relation.
The between relation holds among an Area, a MilitaryUnit, and a Region.
The orientation relation holds among an Artifact, an Object, and a PositionalAttribute.
A Weapon, an Area, and a Region stand in the connects relation.
